info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cash Concentration Management API
info.description: The Cash Concentration Management API facilitates the optimization of cash flows within an organization by enabling adjustments to cash concentration strategies. Through this API, financial institutions can modify parameters related to cash pooling and fund allocation across accounts to enhance liquidity management. Typical consumers include treasury managers and finance teams looking to streamline cash operations and improve cash visibility. This operation is essential for maintaining effective cash positioning and ensuring financial health.
